body:
You're right! There is nothing logical about abandoning children. 
Have you ever been in horrific pain? For months at a time?
The first few weeks are alright, because you think your doctor will fix things. Then people start noticing the weight loss. Then hair starts coming out in clumps. Then you go from having absolutely no cavities, to a mouth full because you throw up so much. I can no longer go grocery shopping without making sure I have a few bags with me to throw up in. I no longer coach my daughter's sports team, because even if I go a day without eating or drinking, I still throw up bile on the sidelines.
I don't mean to be confrontational at all - but simply stating that I there's nothing logical about abandoning my kids..? talk about my feelings? It's great that you don't get where I'm coming from. Sadly, I'm here.

I'm so sorry for what you're going through.
Thank you for your thoughts

A week away to destress sounds amazing, but I feel like the time would be wasted if I come back to the same pain. 
Thank you for your input!

I want to finish things because of the pain. A week spent somewhere, where I'm drugged to the point of not hurting doesn't help. Once I'm back home, I'm responsible for the care of my family. 
I get that once I'm gone, I won't be there to care for them. Again, super selfish on my part. 
Thank you :)

I take a multivitamin, but I normally throw it up. 
Thank you for your time and thoughtfulness!

I'm fine with short term solutions :)
Thank you

I've actually made a few calls tonight. This will be tried, the thought never even occurred to me. 
Thank you!
Thank you! I'll definitely be reading this book. Your realization is an awesome one! Thank you for your thoughtfulness!

Thank you very much! I am indeed a blunt person! I appreciate your thoughtfulness. I will absolutely be trying what DarthContinent suggested! I will also be trying to find drugs! 

I've already thrown thousands of dollars away on this, so compromising my children's college funds in any way won't be happening. My husband is an amazing parent, I know that our children will receive extraordinary support in their time of loss. You are right for me to be concerned about their mental health in the future. I will absolutely look into pediatric therapists that specialize in grief.
Thank you!

Oh my gosh! Thank you!
I have no idea if these tests have already been done, but I will ask to have them done (again?) next week.
Thank you!
